evidence_summary: Prior reviews show decisions often lack rationale and rejected alternatives
Assumption mapping improved clarity in pilot workshop
Scenario comparison changed two of five initiative rankings
Prototype sprint generated evidence before resource commitment
Dashboard metrics risked reducing qualitative judgment to false precision
Participants identified burdens not visible in internal planning
Dependency mapping revealed three sequencing risks
Second-order effects audit revealed incentive feedback risk
Past decisions were difficult to reconstruct due to missing rationale
Option classification revealed overinvestment in immediate actions and underinvestment in learning probes
Explicit criteria revealed disagreement over feasibility versus systems leverage
Pilot feedback often reached operational teams but not strategic decision forums
